根據《路透》，FCC 此次擬禁止的是「新型號」光收發器的進口，主要瞄準支撑 AI 伺服器運算的 800G 與 1.6T 等高速光模組。
不過草案目前仍有大量模糊地帶，究竟現有存量型號、已入關庫存，乃至上游零組件是否一併納入禁令，均尚未定案，這些細節將直接左右最終衝擊的規模。
值得留意的是，報導指出草案設計上將豁免「非中國供應商」，代表打擊面理論上就是鎖定中國品牌本身，而非泛指所有在中國境內生產的光模組。
換言之，若中國品牌在東南亞設廠生產，是否同樣受限仍是未知數。
此外，這並非單一孤立事件。FCC 稍早已於 7 月 22 日投票通過擴大禁令範圍的提案，禁止設備中含有「受管制實體清單」廠商所產邏輯晶片組件的產品進口，代表就算光模組本身不在中國組裝，只要內含中國廠商生產的核心邏輯晶片，同樣可能被納入限制。
往前追溯，FCC 在 7 月 28 日也才剛宣布禁止中國製人形機器人與電力變流器進口，理由同樣扣連「AI 基礎設施國家安全」；消費級路由器的進口限制則更早已上路。
整體看來，這已是川普政府對中科技圍堵政策的延續與升級，只是過去多聚焦於晶片，如今戰線已延伸至 AI 資料中心底層硬體。

產能缺口難補：美系廠半年內接不住中系讓出的訂單

分析指出，儘管消息面激勵美股相關個股走高，市場交易的本質是「訂單移轉」的想像。
若中國新一代光模組被擋在美國市場之外，北美雲端業者的 AI 資本支出勢必轉向本土供應鏈。
其中，祥茂光電作為直接生產高速數通光模組的廠商，被視為最直接的替代標的，股價彈性也最大；Lumentum 與 Coherent 握有雷射器與高速光晶片產能，輝達 (NVDA-US) 先前已透過策略投資鎖定兩者產能，兼具上游晶片供應與整機模組雙重身分；康寧則受惠於資料中心建設帶動的光纖與光互連材料需求，屬於產業鏈間接受惠者。
但分析指出，硬現實是美系廠商目前的有效產能，半年內恐怕遠遠填補不了中國廠商讓出的市場缺口。
市場預估，2025 年全球 1.6T 模組出貨量將上看 420 萬台，加計 800G 模組需求，非中國陣營產能：Lumentum 月產約 10 萬台、AOI 規劃擴至月產 50 萬台、Fabrinet(FN-US) 泰國廠仍在擴產中，合計仍遠不足以承接缺口。
反觀中國光模組廠訂單已排至 2028 年，凸顯供給端本已高度緊繃；中國廠商目前掌握全球逾七成高速光模組產能，其中中際旭創在美國數通光模組市場的市占率更高達約 27%。
分析認為，政策一紙禁令固然可以立即阻斷進口，但產能爬坡、良率優化與大客戶驗證流程曠日費時，絕非短短數月可以補齊，這也被視為後續股價最大的回檔風險所在。
一旦市場意識到紅利兌現週期遠比預期漫長，或最終規則納入大量豁免條款，樂觀溢價恐怕迅速回吐。

摩根士丹利：短期利多美系廠，長期仍卡在磷化銦供應瓶頸

摩根士丹利報告指出，此事件對美系光元件供應鏈屬於正面消息。
以中際旭創與新易盛合計約占全球光收發模組市場一半佔有率的現況推算，具備垂直整合能力的 Coherent 可望成為規模化受惠者最明確的一家，祥茂光電與 Fabrinet 也有機會承接部分增量需求。
與此同時，Lumentum 雖然自身光模組業務曝險相對有限，但其對外供應雷射器予多家模組廠，中國供應商若受限，雷射二極體（EML）供給緊張的緩解時程恐將延後，因此間接受惠。
不過，摩根士丹利的態度也相對謹慎，直言以目前非中國廠商產能，根本難以承接 AI 資本支出帶來的龐大需求。
報告並提及，Lumentum 與 Coherent 兩家公司執行長過去都曾公開倡議類似限制措施，理由是美系廠商普遍無法對中國雲端業者供貨，中國廠商卻能反向供貨給美國市場，形成不對等競爭。
報告也點出最大風險在於磷化銦。此關鍵原料供應主要來自包括 AXT 公司 (AXTI-US) 在內的廠商，Lumentum 上週才剛與相關供應商簽署新協議，Coherent 執行長數月前也隨川普訪中團出訪中國，凸顯美系廠商本身對中國供應鏈仍有依賴，這將是禁令能否落地執行的一大變數。
花旗銀行的看法則更為保留，認為此事不太可能是一刀切式的簡單規則。
花旗提出四大理由：

全球前十大光模組廠中有七家為中國企業，為美國主要雲端服務商供應逾半數高速光模組；
AI 光元件供應鏈本身已相當緊繃，中國龍頭廠商在零組件保障與先進產品研發上仍具關鍵優勢；
中國模組廠具備明顯成本優勢，是雲端業者資本支出效率的重要支撐；
且中國主要光模組廠早已布局海外產線。


基於上述現實，花旗研判最終規則大機率會納入一定豁免條款，海外產能擴張仍將是中國供應商因應的核心策略。

中國廠商曝險不一，新易盛壓力恐最直接

分析稱，若禁令最終落地，中國本土光模組廠受到的衝擊程度也不盡相同。
新易盛 (300502-CN) 對北美客戶依賴度最高，2024 年海外營收占比高達 87%，與中際旭創並列中國出口最積極的兩大光模組廠，2025 年營收約 35 億美元，一旦新品準入受阻，壓力恐最為直接。
中際旭創雖然美國收入占比同樣偏高，但因已提前布局海外產能，緩衝空間相對較大。
分析人士普遍認為，短期衝擊主要來自市場風險偏好轉變，而非業績立即斷崖，後續發展仍充滿不確定性，情勢隨時可能反轉。

兩種劇本：全面禁令 vs. 提高門檻但留活路

展望後續，市場普遍認為存在兩種情境。
第一種情境是草案大致落地，新型光模組直接被擋在美國市場門外，1.6T 及下一代新品幾乎喪失美國入場資格，至於已完成認證的存量 800G 產品，則取決於規則是否設有緩衝窗口期。
短期內可能出現客戶搶在禁令生效前加速拉貨、隨後新品訂單急凍的現象；不過歐洲、中東、東南亞等其他市場，加上中國本土算力建設需求，仍將成為重要緩衝，不至於出現業績全面停滯的局面，同時北美大客戶勢必加速對美系廠商展開導入驗證，只是產能瓶頸將制約實際替代速度。
第二種情境則是禁令歷經遊說角力後大幅弱化，最終僅提高認證門檻，而非直接祭出進口禁令，如此一來市場情緒有望隨利空出盡而修復，行情重新回歸 AI 算力需求本身的基本面邏輯。
值得注意的是，美國本土雲端業者本身其實也是這場政策攻防的利害關係人之一。若強行切斷已相當成熟的中國供應鏈，代價將是算力硬體成本墊高、AI 資料中心擴建進度受拖累。
這也是為何包括輝達在內的科技巨頭，都可能積極投入政策遊說，顯示這項政策絕非行政部門可以片面拍板。
事實上，目前美國資料中心建設已面臨嚴峻延誤，近半數原訂 2026 年投運的 AI 資料中心專案已延遲或取消，原因包括電力基礎設施不足與中國零組件供應受限；美國資料中心平均建置週期長達 3 年，遠慢於中國建設速度。
若禁令真正落地，恐將在本已供需吃緊的光模組市場進一步推升緊張情勢，直接墊高美國 AI 資料中心建設成本並拉長交付時程，對急欲維持 AI 競賽領先地位的美國政府而言，同樣是不願樂見的結果。

觀察：戰線從 GPU 延伸至光模組，供應鏈「雙軌化」恐成長期趨勢

分析認為，放到更宏觀的視角看，這次傳聞的象徵意義恐怕遠大於當下實際衝擊。
過去中美科技角力主戰場集中在 GPU 等運算晶片，如今戰火已延燒至 AI 資料中心底層硬體光模組，顯示整條 AI 基礎設施產業鏈已全面捲入地緣政治博弈。
全球光模組市場過去由中國供應全世界，如今正走向區域割裂：美國市場轉向本土加盟友供應鏈，中國廠商則被迫加速開拓非美市場、加碼海外產線布局。
對光通訊類股而言，過去支撐估值的重要支柱正是北美 AI 算力爆發帶來的訂單動能，這起事件恐迫使市場重新為相關企業的北美業務計入地緣政治風險溢價。
分析人士預期，後續資金將更加青睞兩類標的：

一是海外營收占比較低、國內算力業務比重較高的公司；
二是光晶片自主研發進度領先、海外產能布局較完備的廠商。


整體而言，這項禁令的最終效果仍存在高度不確定性，短期內或對中國光模組龍頭廠商帶來一定衝擊，但同時也可能顯著推升美國 AI 資料中心的建設成本與交付延遲風險。
長期來看，此事件或將加速全球光模組供應鏈走向「雙軌化」，即一條以中國廠商為核心，服務中國及「一帶一路」市場；另一條則以美系企業為主導，服務北美及其盟友市場。
這種分裂格局勢必降低全球供應鏈效率、推升全產業鏈成本，最終恐由全球 AI 產業的所有參與者共同承擔。
paras_en: A Reuters exclusive about a US plan to restrict imports of Chinese optical modules stirred the US‑China optics group on Tuesday night (the 4th). Morgan Stanley believes that if the ban materialises, US suppliers such as Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) could benefit in the short term by picking up orders, but limited capacity and the supply of key materials like indium phosphide (InP) make it hard for US firms to replace China quickly; Citi thinks that because Chinese firms control most of the world’s high‑speed optical module capacity, the final policy is more likely to retain exemption clauses rather than a total ban.

The Trump administration is reportedly drafting a ban that would limit US imports of next‑generation China‑made data‑center optical transceiver modules to strengthen AI infrastructure supply‑chain security. The proposal is being developed by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), which hopes to publish and implement it within the year, though insiders say the final rules could still be altered or shelved.

When the news broke, US‑listed optics stocks surged. AAOI‑US (Xiangmao Optoelectronics) jumped 19% in a day, Coherent and Lumentum rose in tandem, and even upstream fiber‑optic material maker Corning (GLW‑US) surged nearly 9%.
By contrast, Chinese optics stocks slumped on Wednesday (the 5th) at the open, with Zhongji Xuchuang (300308‑CN) down 10.41% intraday and Cambridge Technology (603083‑CN) falling 4.06%.
According to Reuters, the FCC’s draft targets imports of “new‑model” transceivers, mainly the 800G and 1.6T high‑speed modules that power AI servers.

However, the draft leaves many gray areas: it is unclear whether existing inventory, already‑cleared stock, or upstream components will be covered, and those details will directly determine the scale of impact.
The report notes that the draft is designed to exempt “non‑Chinese suppliers,” meaning the ban would theoretically target Chinese‑brand products rather than all modules manufactured in China.
In other words, if a Chinese brand produces modules in Southeast Asia, it is uncertain whether they would be subject to the restriction.

This is not an isolated incident. The FCC earlier voted on July 22 to expand a ban that prohibits imports of equipment containing logic‑chip components from entities on the “Entity List.” Thus, even if a transceiver is not assembled in China, it could be blocked if it contains a core logic chip made by a Chinese supplier.

Looking back, the FCC announced on July 28 a ban on imports of Chinese‑made humanoid robots and power converters, also citing “AI infrastructure national security”; consumer‑grade router restrictions have been in place even earlier.
Overall, this is a continuation and escalation of the Trump administration’s tech containment policy, which previously focused on chips and now extends to the underlying hardware of AI data centers.
Capacity Gap Hard to Fill: US Firms Unlikely to Absorb Chinese Orders Within Six Months

Analysts say that despite the news lifting US‑listed stocks, the market is essentially imagining an “order shift.” If China’s next‑generation optical modules are barred from the US market, North‑American cloud providers’ AI capex will inevitably move toward domestic supply chains.

Xiangmao Optoelectronics, which directly manufactures high‑speed data‑center modules, is seen as the most direct replacement and thus the most volatile; Lumentum and Coherent own laser and high‑speed photonic‑chip capacity, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) has previously secured capacity through strategic investments, giving them both upstream chip and full‑module roles; Corning benefits indirectly from the fiber and optical‑interconnect material demand driven by data‑center builds.
However, analysts point out that the effective capacity of US firms is far from enough to fill the gap left by Chinese players within six months.

The market projects global 1.6T module shipments to reach about 4.2 million units by 2025; adding 800G demand, non‑Chinese capacity – Lumentum at roughly 100,000 units per month, AOI planning to expand to 500,000 per month, and Fabrinet’s (FN‑US) Thailand plant still ramping up – remains far short of the shortfall.

By contrast, Chinese module orders are already booked out to 2028, highlighting a tightly‑strained supply side; Chinese firms currently control over 70% of global high‑speed optical module capacity, with Zhongji Xuchuang holding about a 27% share of the US data‑center module market.

Analysts say a policy paper can instantly block imports, but scaling capacity, improving yields and completing large‑customer qualification processes take months, not weeks, and represent the biggest risk to subsequent stock price rebounds.
If the market realises that the benefit‑realisation cycle is longer than expected, or if the final rules incorporate many exemptions, any optimism premium could be quickly erased.
Morgan Stanley: Short‑Term Upside for US Firms, Long‑Term Bottleneck at Indium Phosphide Supply
Morgan Stanley’s report calls the event a positive for the US optical‑component supply chain.

Based on the fact that Zhongji Xuchuang and XinYiSheng together account for roughly half of the global transceiver market, vertically integrated Coherent is the clearest large‑scale beneficiary, while Xiangmao Optoelectronics and Fabrinet could capture part of the incremental demand.

Lumentum’s own module exposure is limited, but it supplies lasers to many module makers; if Chinese suppliers are restricted, the relief of laser‑diode (EML) shortages could be delayed, giving Lumentum an indirect benefit.
Nevertheless, Morgan Stanley is cautious, stating that current non‑Chinese capacity is simply insufficient to meet the massive AI‑driven demand.

The report notes that both Lumentum and Coherent CEOs have publicly advocated similar restriction measures, arguing that US firms cannot supply Chinese cloud providers while Chinese firms can ship back to the US, creating an uneven playing field.

The biggest risk highlighted is indium phosphide. The key material is sourced from companies including AXT (AXTI‑US); Lumentum only signed a new supply agreement last week, and Coherent’s CEO visited China months ago with the Trump delegation, underscoring US firms’ lingering dependence on Chinese supply chains – a major variable for the ban’s enforceability.
Citi’s View Is More Reserved, Seeing the Likelihood of Exemptions
Citi believes the measure is unlikely to be a blunt, all‑or‑nothing rule.

It gives four reasons: seven of the world’s top ten module makers are Chinese, supplying over half of the high‑speed modules to US cloud providers; the AI optical‑component supply chain is already tight, with Chinese leaders holding key advantages in component security and advanced‑product R&D; Chinese module makers enjoy clear cost advantages that are crucial for cloud‑capex efficiency; and major Chinese module firms have already set up overseas production lines.
Given these realities, Citi forecasts that the final rule will most likely include exemption clauses, and overseas capacity expansion will remain the core strategy for Chinese suppliers.
Chinese Firms Face Varying Levels of Exposure; XinYiSheng May Feel the Brunt
Analysts say that if the ban is implemented, Chinese domestic module makers will be affected to different degrees.

XinYiSheng (300502‑CN) relies heavily on North‑American customers – 87% of its 2024 revenue comes from overseas – and is tied with Zhongji Xuchuang as the most export‑oriented Chinese module makers, with 2025 revenue projected at $3.5 billion; a blockage of new‑model entry would hit it hardest.
Zhongji Xuchuang also has a high US revenue share but has pre‑positioned overseas capacity, giving it a larger buffer.
Analysts generally view the short‑term impact as a shift in market risk appetite rather than an immediate earnings cliff, with considerable uncertainty about how the situation will evolve.
Two Possible Scenarios: Full Ban vs. Higher Barriers with a Path Forward
Looking ahead, the market sees two main scenarios.

Scenario one: the draft largely takes effect, barring new‑model modules from the US market; 1.6T and next‑gen products lose US entry, while already‑certified 800G stock may depend on whether a grace period is built into the rules.

In the short term, customers may rush to pull forward orders before the ban, followed by a freeze on new orders; however, other regions – Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia – and domestic Chinese compute‑capacity demand will provide a buffer, preventing a total earnings standstill, while North‑American megaclients will accelerate qualification of US‑based suppliers, albeit constrained by capacity bottlenecks.

Scenario two: after lobbying, the ban is substantially softened, ending up only raising certification thresholds rather than imposing an outright import ban; market sentiment could then recover as the negative news is priced out, and the rally would revert to the fundamentals of AI compute demand.
It is worth noting that US cloud providers themselves are stakeholders in this policy fight; cutting off a mature Chinese supply chain would raise hardware costs and delay AI data‑center expansion.
That is why tech giants including Nvidia are likely to lobby heavily, showing the policy cannot be decided unilaterally by regulators.

In fact, US data‑center construction is already facing severe delays, with nearly half of AI‑center projects slated for 2026 postponed or cancelled due to power‑infrastructure shortfalls and limited Chinese component supply; US data‑center build cycles average three years, far slower than China’s pace.

If the ban materialises, it would further tighten an already strained optical‑module market, pushing up US AI data‑center construction costs and extending delivery timelines – an outcome the US government, eager to stay ahead in the AI race, does not want.
Observation: The Battle Line Extends from GPUs to Optical Modules, Making a Dual‑Track Supply Chain a Likely Long‑Term Trend
From a macro perspective, the rumor’s symbolic significance may outweigh its immediate impact.

Previously, US‑China tech rivalry centred on GPUs and compute chips; now the conflict has spread to the underlying hardware of AI data‑centers – optical modules – indicating the entire AI infrastructure stack is now embroiled in geopolitical competition.

The global module market, once dominated by Chinese supply, is fragmenting: the US market shifts toward domestic‑friendly supply chains, while Chinese firms accelerate non‑US market penetration and overseas plant construction.
For optics stocks, the key valuation driver – North‑American AI compute‑driven order flow – now carries an added geopolitical risk premium.

Analysts expect capital to favour two types of companies: those with low overseas‑revenue exposure and a higher share of domestic compute business; and those with advanced in‑house photonic‑chip development and well‑established overseas capacity.

Overall, the ultimate effect of the ban remains highly uncertain; in the short term it could dent China’s leading module makers, but it may also significantly raise US AI data‑center build costs and delay deliveries.

In the long run, the episode could accelerate a “dual‑track” global module supply chain: one track centred on Chinese firms serving China and Belt‑and‑Road markets, the other led by US firms serving North America and its allies, a split that would likely reduce overall supply‑chain efficiency and raise industry‑wide costs, ultimately borne by the global AI ecosystem.

items.title: SK海力士獲華爾街齊聲喊買 估值有望追上美光
items.title_en: SK Hynix Gains Wall Street's Approval, Valuation May Catch Up to Micron
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SK 海力士 (SK Hynix)(SKHY-US) 股票正獲得華爾街分析師高度青睞。
這家南韓記憶體晶片大廠的 ADR 股價美國周二 (4 日) 迎來多家券商首次發布研究報告，且大多給予樂觀看法。SK 海力士 ADR 股價終場大漲 8%，報 154.38 美元。
William Blair 分析師 Sebastien Naji 在報告中指出，SK 海力士是「AI 時代的記憶體領導者」，其赴美上市，將有助於縮小與競爭對手美光 (MU-US) 之間的估值差距。
Naji 首次給予 SK 海力士「優於大盤」評級，目標價 260 美元，較周二收盤價仍有約 68% 上漲空間。
就在 Naji 發布報告前數小時，SK 海力士與記憶體廠 SanDisk(SNDK-US) 宣布，共同發布高頻寬快閃記憶體技術藍圖。
Naji 寫道，「AI 記憶體價格維持高檔，加上新增供給擴產速度仍然緩慢，可望持續支撐公司 (SK 海力士) 的獲利能力。」
Stifel Research 分析師 Brian Chin 也首次將 SK 海力士納入研究範圍，給予「買進」評級，目標價 240 美元。
他表示，「我們認為，在需求持續遠高於供給的記憶體市場中，SK 海力士執行力明顯提升，但目前市場仍低估其價值。」
根據 FactSet，Needham、Wedbush、Cantor Fitzgerald、RBC Capital Markets 及 Rosenblatt 等多家券商，也同步給予 SK 海力士「買進」評級。這些分析師平均目標價為 227.84 美元，較週一收盤價仍有約 48% 上漲空間。
今年隨著 AI 基礎設施持續擴建，市場對記憶體晶片需求大幅提升，而供給仍相對吃緊，帶動 SK 海力士、美光及競爭對手三星電子 (Samsung Electronics) 股價同步大漲。
但近一個月來，市場開始質疑 AI 投資熱潮究竟還能持續多久，使相關個股走勢陷入整理。
截至周二，SK 海力士 ADR 的 2026 會計年度預估本益比約為 6.1 倍，相較之下，美光則高達 11.3 倍。Naji 預期，SK 海力士赴美上市後，有助於縮小兩者之間的估值差距，因美國上市將提升公司的長期能見度，並強化其與 AI 及資料中心終端市場的連結。
paras_en: SK Hynix (SKHY-US) stock is gaining favor among Wall Street analysts, according to a report by Barron's.
The South Korean memory chip maker's ADR stock price surged 8% on Tuesday, closing at $154.38 after several brokerages released research reports, most of which were bullish.

William Blair analyst Sebastien Naji said in his report that SK Hynix is the 'leader in memory in the AI era' and its listing in the US will help narrow the valuation gap with its competitor Micron (MU-US).
Naji upgraded SK Hynix to 'outperform' with a target price of $260, representing a potential upside of around 68% from its closing price on Tuesday.
Just hours before Naji's report, SK Hynix and memory chip maker SanDisk (SNDK-US) announced a joint plan to release a high-speed flash memory technology roadmap.
Naji wrote, 'AI memory prices remain high, and the addition of new supply is still growing at a slow pace, which can continue to support the company's (SK Hynix) profitability.'
Stifel Research analyst Brian Chin also initiated coverage of SK Hynix with a 'buy' rating and a target price of $240.
He said, 'We believe that in a memory market where demand continues to far exceed supply, SK Hynix has shown significant improvement in execution, but the market still underestimates its value.'

According to FactSet, several brokerages, including Needham, Wedbush, Cantor Fitzgerald, RBC Capital Markets, and Rosenblatt, also initiated coverage of SK Hynix with a 'buy' rating, with an average target price of $227.84, representing a potential upside of around 48% from its closing price on Monday.

As the AI infrastructure continues to expand this year, the market has seen a significant increase in demand for memory chips, while supply remains relatively tight, driving the stock prices of SK Hynix, Micron, and Samsung Electronics (Samsung Electronics) to surge.
However, in recent weeks, the market has started to question how long the AI investment trend will continue, leading to a correction in the stock prices of related companies.

As of Tuesday, SK Hynix's ADR had an estimated 2026 fiscal year P/E ratio of around 6.1, compared to Micron's 11.3. Naji expects that SK Hynix's listing in the US will help narrow the valuation gap between the two companies, as it will improve the company's long-term visibility and strengthen its connection to the AI and data center end markets.

items.title: AI錢潮下一站在哪？主線轉向應用端 微軟可望吞「變現大餅」
items.title_en: Where's the Next AI Wave? Microsoft May Be Poised to Capture the AI Revenue Pie
paras: 人工智慧（AI）浪潮推動全球科技巨頭投入龐大資本支出，過去兩年市場焦點主要集中於資料中心、晶片、伺服器與能源等基礎建設領域。然而，隨著 AI 基礎設施逐步完善，市場關注焦點正開始從「誰能提供算力」轉向「誰能透過 AI 創造實際收入」。
高盛認為，AI 投資主線正迎來重要切換，市場將逐漸從基建階段邁向應用變現階段。過去依靠雲端服務商持續擴大資本支出所帶動的成長模式，未來將更重視企業採用、商業模式與獲利能力。
市場對 AI 基礎建設公司的評價邏輯也正在改變。過去投資人更關注企業是否能受惠於雲端巨頭加碼資本支出，但在新的階段，收入、利潤與現金流能否相互驗證，將成為市場評估企業價值的重要標準。
AI 需求從實驗室走向企業端
AI 商業化進程正在加速。過去市場曾擔憂，雲端服務商投入大量資金支持 AI 模型公司，形成「左手倒右手」的循環融資模式，質疑 AI 基礎建設支出的真實需求。
不過，近期企業端需求開始浮現，AI 應用正逐步從少數 AI 實驗室擴散至傳統產業。資料顯示，微軟商業剩餘履約義務的成長主要來自非實驗室客戶，顯示企業對 AI 服務的採用正在擴大。
這意味著 AI 產業鏈的價值分配正在改變。市場不再只是追逐提供算力的企業，而是尋找能將 AI 技術導入企業流程、提高生產效率並形成收入模式的公司。
微軟掌握 AI 變現優勢
在 AI 應用變現階段，微軟 (MSFT-US) 被視為最具優勢的受益者之一。市場分析指出，微軟與 AWS 目前是較能證明 AI 商業模式的企業，其中微軟擁有 Copilot 與 Foundry 等多層收入出口。
微軟的 AI 布局形成多層次收入模式。Azure 提供基礎雲端算力與 GPU 租賃服務，Foundry 平台提供模型調用、微調與部署能力，而 Copilot 則直接嵌入 Office 365 與 GitHub 等企業應用場景，透過付費席位模式創造收入。
這種從基礎設施到平台，再到終端應用的完整布局，使微軟不僅能受惠於 AI 資本支出，也有機會進一步捕捉企業導入 AI 後帶來的商業價值。
市場開始尋找 AI 獲利答案
隨著 AI 產業進入下一階段，投資人評估標準將逐步從「投入多少資金」轉向「能創造多少回報」。過去兩年，雲端服務商持續提高資本支出，帶動 AI 供應鏈享受成長紅利，但未來市場將更重視企業是否能將投資轉化為實際營收與獲利。
高盛研判，AI 主線正在從基礎建設淘金階段，進入應用價值釋放階段。在這場產業轉換中，具備雲端平台、企業軟體與 AI 應用生態的企業，有望成為下一階段市場關注焦點，而微軟正是其中的重要代表。
paras_en: The AI wave has driven global tech giants to invest heavily, with the past two years focusing on data centers, chips, servers, and energy infrastructure. However, as AI infrastructure becomes increasingly mature, market attention is shifting from "who can provide computing power" to "who can create actual revenue through AI".

Goldman Sachs believes that AI investment is entering a critical phase, with the market gradually transitioning from the infrastructure stage to the application monetization stage. The growth model driven by cloud service providers' continuous capital expenditures in the past will give way to enterprise adoption, business models, and profitability.

Market evaluation logic for AI infrastructure companies is also changing. In the past, investors were more concerned with whether companies could benefit from cloud giants' increased capital expenditures, but in the new stage, income, profit, and cash flow will be the key standards for evaluating a company's value.
AI demand is shifting from laboratories to enterprise ends.

The commercialization of AI is accelerating. In the past, the market was concerned that cloud service providers had invested heavily in AI model companies, forming a "left-hand-right-hand" circular financing model, questioning the real demand for AI infrastructure investments.

However, in recent times, enterprise demand has emerged, and AI applications are gradually spreading from a few AI laboratories to traditional industries. Data shows that Microsoft's commercial remaining performance obligations (RPO) growth mainly comes from non-laboratory customers, indicating that enterprises are increasingly adopting AI services.

This means that the value distribution in the AI industry chain is changing. The market is no longer just chasing companies that can provide computing power, but rather seeking companies that can introduce AI technology into enterprise processes, improve production efficiency, and create income models.
Microsoft has a strong advantage in AI monetization.

In the AI application monetization stage, Microsoft (MSFT-US) is seen as one of the most favored beneficiaries. Market analysis shows that Microsoft and AWS are currently the most capable companies to prove AI business models, with Microsoft owning Copilot and Foundry, which have multiple revenue streams.

Microsoft's AI layout forms a multi-layered income model. Azure provides basic cloud computing power and GPU rental services, while Foundry provides model invocation, fine-tuning, and deployment capabilities. Copilot, on the other hand, directly embeds into Office 365 and GitHub enterprise application scenarios, creating revenue through paid seat models.

This complete layout, from infrastructure to platform to end-user applications, enables Microsoft not only to benefit from AI capital expenditures but also to capture the commercial value brought by enterprises adopting AI.
The market is starting to look for AI profitability answers.

As the AI industry enters the next stage, investment standards will gradually shift from "how much capital is invested" to "how much return can be created". In the past two years, cloud service providers have continuously increased capital expenditures, driving the AI supply chain to enjoy growth dividends, but in the future, the market will focus more on whether companies can convert investments into actual revenue and profits.

Goldman Sachs predicts that the AI mainline is transitioning from the infrastructure gold rush stage to the application value release stage. In this industry transformation, companies with cloud platforms, enterprise software, and AI application ecosystems will become the focus of market attention in the next stage, and Microsoft is an important representative.

items.title: 美光挑戰全球第二！DRAM市占升至25% 中國CXMT加速擴張成隱憂
items.title_en: Micron Challenges Global No. 2! DRAM Market Share Rises to 25% China's CXMT Accelerates Expansion, Becoming a Concern
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，美光科技 (MU-US) 週二勁揚 7.62%，收在每股 892.67 美元，盤中一度觸及 902.43 美元、漲幅達 8.8%。最新數據顯示，美光第二季在全球 DRAM 市場持續擴張，營收市占率已逼近 SK 海力士，但中國記憶體業者長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 快速崛起，也為產業競爭增添變數。
根據 Counterpoint Research 統計，美光第二季 DRAM 營收市占率由第一季的 22% 升至 25%。DRAM 約占美光整體營收近八成，因此市占率提升對公司業績具有重要意義。
目前，美光與排名第二的 SK 海力士差距已明顯縮小。SK 海力士第二季市占率為 26%，三星電子則以 39% 穩居全球第一。
Counterpoint Research 研究副總裁 Neil Shah 指出，美光的 DRAM 營收較 2025 年第二季成長約五倍，目前已具備超越 SK 海力士、躍居全球第二的條件。接下來競爭的關鍵，在於各家供應商能否提供足夠產能，把握記憶體需求與價格上漲帶來的商機。
不過，市占率快速上升的並非只有美光。長鑫存儲第二季拿下約 7% 的全球 DRAM 市占率，較去年同期成長超過八倍，擴張速度不容忽視。
Shah 認為，如果長鑫存儲能進一步提升產能與技術能力，除了滿足中國市場需求，也逐步打入個人電腦及國際一線客戶供應鏈，其全球市占率一年後可能呈現截然不同的樣貌。市場關注的焦點，已從長鑫存儲能否進入全球記憶體前三大，轉向何時能夠達成。
長鑫存儲目前主要集中於傳統 DRAM，但也開始將目標轉向人工智慧 (AI) 伺服器不可或缺的高頻寬記憶體 (HBM)。研究機構 SemiAnalysis 預估，長鑫存儲占全球 HBM 晶圓供應的比重，可能由 2025 年的 1% 升至 2028 年的 12%。
儘管中國競爭對手持續擴產，美銀全球研究分析師 Vivek Arya 仍看好美光。他認為，美光近期股價修正，主要反映投資人提前布局未來可能出現的產業下行週期，而非公司基本面明顯惡化。
Arya 指出，即使採用較悲觀的情境估算，美光每股盈餘仍可能超過 100 美元，遠高於 2018 年上一輪記憶體景氣高峰時約 12 美元的水準。此外，美光與客戶簽訂的多年期長約日益增加，有助提升供需能見度，並降低記憶體價格大幅波動的風險。
AI 需求同樣構成支撐。Arya 表示，繪圖處理器 (GPU) 搭配 HBM 的使用率仍接近歷史高點，即使零組件成本上升，大型雲端服務商仍持續擴大資本支出，顯示半導體及記憶體供應商仍具有一定的定價能力。
對於長鑫存儲的威脅，美銀認為，其產能雖積極擴張，目標可能達到全球晶圓產能的低雙位數百分比，但目前產品仍以消費性及標準型 DRAM 為主，與美光主攻的 HBM3E 及 HBM4 等高階 AI 記憶體並不完全重疊。
此外，美國企業能否獲准採購長鑫存儲產品仍存在不確定性。在美國本土 AI 基礎設施持續擴建、先進 HBM 競爭者相對有限的情況下，美銀認為美光仍具備成長優勢。
Arya 重申對美光的「買進」評級，目標價維持在 1,550 美元。美光股價今年截至週二收盤已累計上漲 213%，過去 12 個月更飆升近 719%；不過，近一個月仍回落約 12%，反映市場一方面看好 AI 記憶體需求，另一方面也在評估產業週期與中國供應商擴張帶來的風險。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US) surged 7.62% on Tuesday, closing at $892.67 per share, and briefly touched $902.43, a gain of 8.8%. The latest data shows that Micron continued to expand its market share in the global DRAM market in the second quarter, with its revenue market share approaching that of SK Hynix, but Chinese memory maker CXMT is rapidly rising, adding uncertainty to the industry.

According to Counterpoint Research, Micron's second-quarter DRAM revenue market share rose to 25% from 22% in the first quarter. DRAM accounts for nearly 80% of Micron's total revenue, so the increase in market share is significant for the company's performance.

Currently, Micron's market share is significantly narrowing the gap with second-place SK Hynix. SK Hynix's second-quarter market share was 26%, while Samsung Electronics maintained its global lead with a 39% market share.

Counterpoint Research Vice President Neil Shah pointed out that Micron's DRAM revenue grew by about five times in the second quarter of 2025, and it now has the conditions to surpass SK Hynix and become the global No. 2. The key to competition is whether suppliers can provide sufficient capacity to seize the opportunities brought by the growth in memory demand and prices.

However, the market share is not rising only for Micron. CXMT's second-quarter global DRAM market share was around 7%, a growth of more than eight times from the same period last year, with an expansion speed that cannot be ignored.

Shah believes that if CXMT can further improve its capacity and technical capabilities, it can not only meet the demand of the Chinese market but also gradually enter the supply chain of international first-line customers and personal computers, and its global market share may show a completely different picture in a year.
The focus of market attention has shifted from whether CXMT can enter the top three in the global memory market to when it can achieve it.

CXMT currently mainly focuses on traditional DRAM, but it has also begun to target high-frequency wide memory (HBM) for AI servers, which is indispensable. Research firm SemiAnalysis estimates that CXMT's share of global HBM wafer supply may rise from 1% in 2025 to 12% in 2028.

Although Chinese competitors continue to expand production, Goldman Sachs global research analyst Vivek Arya remains optimistic about Micron. He believes that Micron's recent stock price correction mainly reflects investors' early layout for the possible industry downturn in the future, rather than a significant deterioration in the company's fundamentals.

Arya pointed out that even under a more pessimistic scenario, Micron's earnings per share may still exceed $100, far higher than the $12 level in 2018, the previous memory boom. In addition, Micron's multi-year contracts with customers are increasing, which helps to improve supply and demand visibility and reduce the risk of significant fluctuations in memory prices.

AI demand also provides support. Arya said that the usage rate of GPUs paired with HBM is still close to the historical high, even if component costs rise, large cloud service providers continue to expand their capital expenditures, showing that semiconductor and memory suppliers still have some pricing power.

Regarding the threat from CXMT, Goldman Sachs believes that its production capacity is expanding aggressively, but its products are mainly consumer-grade and standard DRAM, which do not completely overlap with Micron's HBM3E and HBM4, high-end AI memory.

In addition, there is uncertainty about whether US companies can obtain permission to purchase CXMT products. In the context of the continuous expansion of AI infrastructure in the US and the limited competition in advanced HBM, Goldman Sachs believes that Micron still has growth advantages.

Arya reiterated his 'buy' rating for Micron, with a target price of $1,550. Micron's stock price has risen by 213% as of Tuesday's close this year and has surged by nearly 719% in the past 12 months, but it has fallen by about 12% in the past month, reflecting the market's optimism about AI memory demand and its evaluation of the industry cycle and the risks brought by Chinese suppliers' expansion.

items.title: 半導體股強勢反攻！Marvell、SanDisk、SK海力士ADR領軍狂飆
items.title_en: Semiconductor Stocks Surge: Marvell, SanDisk, SK Hynix ADR Lead the Charge
paras: 半導體股週二 (4 日) 強勢反攻，費城半導體指數盤中大漲逾 6%，成為推升美股的主要力量，並帶動標普 500 指數再創新高。市場一方面看好人工智慧 (AI) 帶來的記憶體與儲存需求，另一方面也提前布局超微 (AMD-US) 盤後公布的財報。
記憶體與儲存類股漲勢尤其突出。美光 (MU-US) 與 SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 狂飆約 8%，SanDisk (SNDK-US) 飛漲逾 10%；網通晶片商 Marvell (MRVL-US) 噴高約 13%。
其他主要晶片股同步走高，超微在盤後公布財報前強升約 10%，英特爾 (INTC-US) 暴漲超 10%，博通 (AVGO-US) 漲逾 6%，AI 晶片龍頭輝達 (NVDA-US) 則上漲 2.56%。
這波行情的其中一項催化劑，來自本週在加州登場的 2026 年快閃記憶體峰會 (Flash Memory Summit) 。
Marvell 在活動中推出一系列針對 AI 最佳化的記憶體與儲存基礎設施產品，希望因應代理式 AI 推論快速增加的運算與資料處理需求，進一步點燃市場對相關供應鏈的期待。
除了新品題材，超微財報也是市場關注焦點。該公司預定週二美股盤後公布季度業績，投資人押注財報與財測可能引發股價劇烈波動。
芝加哥選擇權交易所 (Cboe) 資深副總裁 JJ Kinahan 表示，超微過去在財測方面通常相當準確，最近 12 次財報公布的結果與市場預期差距多在每股 1 美分以內。不過，即使業績符合預期，超微在其中超過一半的財報公布後仍然下跌，顯示投資人對本次財報的要求不低。
半導體股週二領漲，也協助標普 500 指數與道瓊工業指數登歷史新高。不過，這次反彈出現在一段劇烈修正之後。受到大型雲端服務商大舉投入 AI、資本支出回報遭到質疑等因素影響，半導體類股上月一度較高點下跌超過 20%，進入技術性熊市。
中國 AI 技術快速進展同樣曾壓抑市場情緒。中國業者以較低成本開發 AI 模型，使投資人開始擔心，美國科技巨頭投入巨額資金興建資料中心及採購晶片，未來能否取得足以支撐估值的回報。
paras_en: Semiconductor stocks rallied on Tuesday (4th) with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surging over 6% during the day, becoming a major driving force behind the US stock market and pushing the S&P 500 index to a new high. Market participants are optimistic about the demand for memory and storage driven by artificial intelligence (AI) and are also positioning themselves ahead of AMD's (AMD-US) earnings report after the market close.

Memory and storage-related stocks are particularly notable for their surge. Micron (MU-US) and SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) skyrocketed by around 8%, while SanDisk (SNDK-US) soared over 10%. Marvell (MRVL-US) surged by around 13%.

Other major chip stocks also rose in sync, with AMD surging by around 10% before its earnings report, Intel (INTC-US) surging over 10%, Broadcom (AVGO-US) rising by over 6%, and AI chip leader NVIDIA (NVDA-US) rising by 2.56%.
One of the catalysts for this trend is the upcoming 2026 Flash Memory Summit in California.

Marvell unveiled a series of memory and storage infrastructure products optimized for AI at the event, hoping to meet the increasing computational and data processing demands driven by proxy AI inference and further fuel market expectations for related supply chains.

In addition to new product themes, AMD's earnings report is also a major focus of attention. The company is scheduled to release its quarterly earnings after the US stock market close on Tuesday, with investors betting that the report and earnings estimates may trigger significant price volatility.

JJ Kinahan, a senior vice president at the Chicago Board Options Exchange (Cboe), noted that AMD has historically been quite accurate in its earnings estimates, with the difference between actual and expected results being within $0.01 per share in most of its past 12 earnings reports. However, even if the earnings meet expectations, AMD has fallen in more than half of its past earnings reports, indicating that investors have high expectations for this report.

Semiconductor stocks led the charge on Tuesday, also helping the S&P 500 index and the Dow Jones Industrial Average to reach new highs. However, this rebound occurred after a sharp correction. Factors such as large cloud service providers investing heavily in AI, questioned capital expenditure returns, and China's rapid AI technology advancements have all weighed on the market's sentiment.

China's AI technology advancements have also suppressed market sentiment. Chinese companies have developed AI models at lower costs, causing investors to worry that US tech giants' massive investments in building data centers and purchasing chips may not yield sufficient returns to support their valuations.

items.title: Fed華許避談利率展望引爭議 貝森特力挺：市場該自己做功課
items.title_en: Fed's Warsh Avoids Rate Outlook, Sparks Controversy; Bessent Defends: Market Must Do Its Own Homework
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 在上任後主持的第二場會議中，對未來利率政策方向保持緘默，卻無法消除各界對 Fed 抑制通膨的疑慮，為此美國財長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 發聲力挺。
貝森特周二 (4 日) 接受 CNBC 訪問時說：「我 1984 年進入華爾街時，你從來不知道 Fed 下一步會怎麼做，市場必須據此自行布局，也必須自己做好研究。」
對於華許不再預先暗示利率方向的作法，貝森特形容：「我認為這是一場『戒斷療程』(detox)，不只是金融市場，也包括財經記者。」
貝森特的發言，凸顯支持華許與批評者之間的分歧。
支持者認為，減少「前瞻指引」有助於 Fed 回歸政策獨立性。批評者則認為，在華許持續強調打擊通膨的同時，卻未交代具體政策路徑，只會增加市場不確定性。
華許一再表示，Fed 仍致力將通膨降回 2% 目標，但 Fed 上周以 9 比 3 決議，連續第五次將聯邦基金利率維持在 3.5% 至 3.75%。他在會後記者會表示：「目前是一段保持審慎觀察的時期。」
市場質疑：沒有策略 如何讓人相信能壓制通膨？
加拿大《BMO Capital Markets》首席經濟學家 Douglas Porter 指出，真正令市場意外的是，華許對通膨展現強硬態度，卻沒有透露近期可能採取任何政策行動。
美國銀行全球研究 (BofA Global Research) 利率策略主管 Mark Cabana 則比喻，華許就像一個宣稱要減重 15 磅的人，但既不運動、也不節食、更不用 GLP-1 減重藥物。
Cabana 說：「光有決心很好，但若不說明要怎麼做到，就沒有人會相信你。你騙不了債券市場的。」市場上周的反應，正反映投資人對 Fed 政策可信度的疑慮。
債市示警 Fed 公信力受考驗
多數經濟學家認為，若要有效壓低通膨，仍須透過升息。
儘管 Fed 依法獨立於白宮運作，但市場與政策制定者仍密切觀察，華許是否會偏向川普政府主張的降息立場。
曾任紐約聯準銀行總裁的杜雷 (Bill Dudley) 表示，長天期公債殖利率上升，代表市場對 Fed 公信力下降，「華許幾乎沒有透露 Fed 如何思考貨幣政策，也沒有說明 Fed 將如何依據經濟數據調整政策。他的沉默幾乎震耳欲聾。」
Apollo 全球管理公司首席經濟學家 Torsten Slok 也表示，市場無法理解 Fed 將如何讓通膨回落，因此推升長天期殖利率，「因為市場開始擔心，控制通膨可能需要更長時間，甚至可能出現政策失誤。」
與川普關係密切 放大市場檢視
另一方面，也有分析認為，華許之所以遭受比歷任 Fed 主席更嚴格的檢視，是因為外界普遍認為他與美國總統川普關係密切。
FAO Economics 首席經濟學家 Robert Brusca 說：「市場始終深深懷疑，華許骨子裡就是川普的人，最終會配合川普的政策。除非他證明事實並非如此，否則市場恐怕難以真正信任他。」
儘管公債殖利率走高，意味政府借貸成本增加，也可能拖累經濟，貝森特仍公開支持華許。他說：「我認為華許希望保留政策選項，以爭取最佳結果。我相信在他的領導下，Fed 將能兼顧經濟成長與抑制通膨兩大使命。」
對於市場押注 Fed 可能再次升息，貝森特則不以為然。他反問：「短期利率上升究竟能帶來什麼效果？」
貝森特指出，即使 Fed 現在升息，其影響通常也要一年甚至更久才會反映到經濟，而且，扣除能源等價格波動較大的項目後，美國的核心通膨其實相當平穩，貝森特說：「我認為這種情況還會持續下去。」
paras_en: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh, in the second meeting he has chaired since taking office, remained silent on the future direction of interest-rate policy, failing to allay concerns about the Fed's ability to curb inflation. In response, U.S. Treasury official Scott Bessent voiced his support.
Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday (the 4th) that "when I entered Wall Street in 1984, you never knew what the Fed would do next; the market has to position itself accordingly and do its own research."
Regarding Warsh's decision to stop pre‑emptively signaling rate direction, Bessent described it as "a detox, not just for financial markets but also for financial journalists."
Bessent's remarks highlight the split between Warsh's supporters and his critics.

Supporters argue that reducing forward guidance helps the Fed regain policy independence. Critics say that while Warsh continues to stress fighting inflation, he offers no concrete policy path, which only adds market uncertainty.

Warsh repeatedly said the Fed remains committed to bringing inflation back to its 2% target, and last week the Fed voted 9‑3 to keep the federal funds rate at 3.5%‑3.75% for the fifth consecutive meeting. He told reporters after the meeting that "we are in a period of cautious observation."
The market questions: without a strategy, how can anyone be convinced the Fed can suppress inflation?
Douglas Porter, chief economist at BMO Capital Markets, noted that the real surprise to the market is Warsh's tough stance on inflation without revealing any near‑term policy actions.

Mark Cabana, head of rate strategy at BofA Global Research, likened Warsh to someone who says they want to lose 15 pounds but neither exercises, diets, nor uses GLP‑1 weight‑loss drugs. "Having determination is fine, but if you don’t explain how to achieve it, no one will believe you. You can’t fool the bond market," he said. Last week’s market reaction reflected investors' doubts about the credibility of Fed policy.
Bond markets warn that the Fed's credibility is being tested.
Most economists still believe that lowering inflation effectively requires further rate hikes.
Although the Fed operates independently of the White House by law, markets and policymakers closely watch whether Warsh will lean toward the Trump administration’s preferred rate‑cut stance.

Bill Dudley, former president of the New York Fed, said that rising long‑term Treasury yields signal a decline in confidence in the Fed, adding that "Warsh has almost no indication of how the Fed thinks about monetary policy, nor how it will adjust policy based on economic data. His silence is almost deafening."

Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, also said the market cannot understand how the Fed will bring inflation down, pushing up long‑term yields "because the market is beginning to worry that controlling inflation may take longer or that policy mistakes could occur."
On the other hand, some analysts argue that Warsh is under stricter scrutiny than previous Fed chairs because many believe he is closely aligned with President Trump.

Robert Brusca, chief economist at FAO Economics, said, "The market deeply suspects that Warsh is fundamentally a Trump person and will ultimately follow Trump’s policies. Unless he proves otherwise, the market will find it hard to truly trust him."

Even though higher Treasury yields raise government borrowing costs and could drag on the economy, Bessent publicly backed Warsh, saying, "I think Warsh wants to keep policy options open to achieve the best outcome. I believe under his leadership the Fed can balance economic growth and inflation control."
When asked about the market’s bet that the Fed may raise rates again, Bessent was dismissive, asking, "What does a short‑term rate increase actually achieve?"

Bessent pointed out that even if the Fed raises rates now, the effects typically take a year or more to filter through the economy, and that core U.S. inflation—excluding volatile energy prices—has been fairly stable. He added, "I think this situation will continue."

items.title: 印度央行維持利率不變 在通膨壓力與地緣政治迷霧中尋求韌性
items.title_en: India's Central Bank Keeps Rates Unchanged Amid Inflation Pressure and Geopolitical Uncertainty
paras: 印度央行 (RBI) 周三 (5 日) 宣布將基準利率維持在 5.25%，這是央行連續第五次維持利率不變。儘管印度的零售通膨率已突破了 4% 的中期目標，由總裁馬洛特拉 (Sanjay Malhotra) 領導的貨幣政策委員會仍全體一致投票通過維持回購利率，並保持中立的政策立場。
數據顯示，受油價飆升影響，印度 6 月份消費者物價指數 (CPI) 觸及 18 個月高點 4.38%。雖然整體通膨超標，但馬洛特拉強調，核心通膨 (不含食品與能源) 仍維持在 3.7% 的適度水準，且目前尚未看到價格壓力全面擴散的跡象。
央行預計，整體通膨將在第三季達到峰值後回落，並將全年度通膨預測從 5.1% 略微下調至 5.0%。
印度目前仍是全球增長最快的主要經濟體之一，1 月至 3 月季度的 GDP 成長率達 7.8%。然而，未來的經濟前景顯得「模糊」。馬洛特拉指出，西南季風的不確定性、聖嬰現象 (El Niño) 以及中東地區 (特別是伊朗) 的衝突，都為成長帶來挑戰。
由於印度約 85% 至 90% 的燃料需求依賴進口，地緣政治引發的能源價格波動是最大的隱憂。
政策公布後，印度基準 Nifty 50 指數表現持平，10 年期國債殖利率則下滑至約 6.77%。在匯率方面，儘管印度盧比在政策公布後交易價格略有回升，但受資本外流與地緣政治導致的美元走強影響，盧比今年仍是亞洲表現最差的貨幣之一。
雖然央行目前選擇觀望，但匯豐銀行 (HSBC) 等研究機構警告，若通膨從 10 月起連續八個月維持在 5% 以上，央行將難以坐視不管。許多經濟學家預測，隨著 8 月底 GDP 數據的公布，若通膨壓力持續，印度央行可能會在 10 月或 12 月開啟升息循環。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced on Wednesday that it would keep its benchmark interest rate at 5.25%, marking the fifth consecutive time the central bank has left rates unchanged. Despite India's retail inflation rate exceeding the 4% medium-term target, the Monetary Policy Committee, led by Governor Sanjay Malhotra, unanimously voted to maintain the repo rate and retain a neutral policy stance.

Data showed that India's consumer price index (CPI) reached an 18-month high of 4.38% in June, driven by rising oil prices. Although overall inflation exceeded the target, Malhotra emphasized that core inflation (excluding food and energy) remained moderate at 3.7% and that there were no signs of broad-based price pressures.
The central bank expects overall inflation to peak in the third quarter before easing and has slightly lowered its full-year inflation forecast to 5.0% from 5.1%.

India remains one of the fastest-growing major economies, with a GDP growth rate of 7.8% in the January-March quarter. However, the economic outlook is 'uncertain'. Malhotra cited the uncertainty of the southwest monsoon, the El Niño phenomenon, and conflicts in the Middle East (particularly in Iran) as challenges to growth.
As India relies on imports for 85-90% of its fuel needs, geopolitical tensions that lead to energy price volatility are a major concern.

Following the policy announcement, the Nifty 50 index was little changed, while the 10-year government bond yield fell to around 6.77%. The Indian rupee, which had initially risen after the policy announcement, remains one of the worst-performing currencies in Asia this year due to capital outflows and a strong US dollar driven by geopolitical tensions.

Although the central bank has chosen to wait and watch for now, research institutions such as HSBC have warned that if inflation remains above 5% from October for eight consecutive months, the RBI will find it difficult to remain inactive. Many economists predict that if inflationary pressures persist, the RBI may start a rate hike cycle in October or December, following the release of GDP data at the end of August.

items.title: 「大賣空」貝瑞續看空：美股逼近重大高點 恐重演1987年股災
items.title_en: Michael Burry Continues to Bet Against the Market: S&P 500 Approaching a Major High Point, Risking a Repeat of the 1987 Crash
paras: 《CNBC》報導，即使美股標普 500 指數持續創下歷史新高，因電影《大賣空》(The Big Short) 聲名大噪的投資人貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 仍堅持其看空立場，甚至警告這輪漲勢最終可能演變成類似 1987 年股災。
貝瑞周二 (4 日) 在 Substack 發文表示，「我仍然認為，市場可能正逼近一個重大高點，也不排除出現類似 1987 年的崩跌。不過，標普 500 持續創下新高，很可能會吸引更多新的資金進場。」
標普 500 指數周二大漲 1.9%，創下 6 月以來首個歷史收盤新高。企業財報優於預期，加上市場預期荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 可望重新開放航運，帶動油價進一步下跌，共同激勵市場走高。以科技股為主的那斯達克綜合指數則大漲 2.7%，本周前兩個交易日累計漲幅已接近 5%。
貝瑞一直是華爾街最著名的 AI 熱潮懷疑論者之一。他認為，目前市場對 AI 基礎設施的需求，很大程度是建立在各種融資安排上，而這種模式未必具長期可持續性。
他表示，市場漲勢正形成一個自我強化的循環，隨著波動率下降，系統化投資人也會增加市場曝險。
貝瑞寫道，「記住，當市場在波動率下降的情況下持續上漲時，以波動率為目標的基金就會被迫提高槓桿，而其他動能交易策略也會進一步加碼。」
儘管美股持續走高，貝瑞表示，他目前仍維持多筆放空部位，包括 iShares 半導體 ETF(SOXX-US)、美光 (MU-US)、輝達 (NVDA-US)、開拓重工 (CAT-US)、Palantir(PLTR)、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 及應用材料 (AMAT-US)。
這位知名投資人表示，他仍對這些放空部位的長期看法充滿信心。但他也強調，若市場走勢明顯與他的判斷相反，他會選擇停損。
他透露，目前除了做空輝達仍處於虧損外，其餘放空部位目前都維持獲利。
貝瑞最後也提醒投資人，「再次強調，做空並不適合每個人。我必須放空，但大多數人不應該這麼做。」
paras_en: CNBC reported that despite the S&P 500 index continuing to set new historical highs, investor Michael Burry, who was featured in the film The Big Short, remains bearish on the market and warns that the current rally may ultimately turn into a crash similar to 1987.

Burry wrote on Substack on Tuesday (4th) that "I still believe that the market may be approaching a major high point, and it's not ruled out that we could see a crash like 1987. However, the S&P 500 continues to set new highs, which may attract more new capital into the market."

The S&P 500 index rose 1.9% on Tuesday, setting a new historical closing high since June. Strong corporate earnings and expectations of the Strait of Hormuz reopening, leading to further declines in oil prices, drove the market higher. The Nasdaq Composite Index, led by tech stocks, rose 2.7%, with a cumulative gain of nearly 5% over the past two trading days.

Burry has been one of the most well-known skeptics of the AI hype on Wall Street. He believes that the current market demand for AI infrastructure is largely based on various financing arrangements, which may not be sustainable in the long term.
He noted that the market is forming a self-reinforcing cycle, with decreasing volatility leading to increased market exposure by systematic investors.

Burry wrote, "Remember, when the market continues to rise in a low-volatility environment, funds targeting volatility will be forced to increase leverage, and other momentum trading strategies will further add to the market's exposure."

Despite the market's continued rise, Burry stated that he still maintains short positions in several stocks, including the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US), Micron (MU-US), NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Caterpillar (CAT-US), Palantir (PLTR), Tesla (TSLA-US), and Applied Materials (AMAT-US)."
Burry emphasized that he remains confident in his long-term views on these short positions but also noted that he will close his positions if the market trend contradicts his expectations.
He revealed that, except for his short position in NVIDIA, which is currently in the red, all his other short positions are currently profitable.
Burry also reminded investors that "I must short, but most people should not."

items.title: AI記憶體行情未見頂！高盛力挺三星、SK海力士、解析「8大焦點」
items.title_en: AI Memory Market Unseen Peak! Goldman Sachs Supports Samsung, SK Hynix, and Analyzes '8 Key Points'
paras: 近期南韓記憶體雙雄三星電子 (005930KS) 與 SK 海力士 (000660KS) 股價大幅修正，引發市場對 AI 記憶體景氣是否見頂的疑慮。不過，高盛最新研究報告認為，市場目前對 HBM、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）定價、長期供貨協議（LTA）、庫存、中國競爭以及股東回饋等議題存在過度悲觀的解讀，導致兩家公司估值已明顯偏離基本面，因此維持「買進」評等。
高盛指出，過去一個月三星電子與 SK 海力士股價分別回落約 23% 及 35%，使兩家公司 2027 年預估本益比降至約 3.5 至 3.6 倍，股價淨值比也僅約 1.4 至 1.6 倍，反映市場對未來獲利持續性的高度疑慮，但與實際產業供需情況並不相符。

HBM 價格可望續揚 2027 年均價恐翻倍

高盛最看好的仍是 HBM 市場前景。報告預估，2027 年三星與 SK 海力士 HBM 平均售價將分別年增約 87% 及 100%，每 Gb 價格皆有望接近 2.9 美元，明顯高於市場普遍預期。
高盛認為，AI 伺服器需求持續快速成長，但新一代 HBM 因製程更先進、堆疊層數增加，使良率提升更加困難，加上 HBM 生產會消耗更多 DRAM 晶圓，導致供給擴張速度仍難追上需求，預估 2027 年的供需缺口甚至將比今年更加吃緊。
此外，目前一般 DRAM 價格因採月度或季度議價，已率先反映市場行情，反而高於多採年度合約的 HBM 價格。
高盛預期，隨著一般 DRAM 價格走高，HBM 未來將重新建立價格溢價，並逐步回到符合其高附加價值的獲利水準。
在此帶動下，高盛估計 HBM 占兩家公司 DRAM 營收比重將持續提升，三星可望由今年約 8% 提高至 2027 年的 16%，SK 海力士則由 14% 增至 22%，2028 年還將進一步攀升。

長約談判轉向供應商有利 預付款機制成新亮點

除了價格前景，高盛也指出，AI 帶動供應長期吃緊，使大型客戶積極與記憶體廠簽署長期供貨協議（LTA），而最新合約內容普遍更有利於供應商。
報告指出，目前 LTA 主要呈現四大趨勢，包括合約期限拉長、涵蓋產能提高、價格機制更具保護性，以及增加預付款等約束條件。
其中，多數合約已由過去短約延長至 5 年左右，部分為 3 年，三星則表示旗下長約採滾動續約模式，實際合作時間可能超過 5 年。
覆蓋率方面，多家業者已將長約涵蓋比例提高至 60% 至 70% 產能；價格方面，則逐步採用價格上下限或最低價格保障機制，以降低市場波動風險。
高盛認為，本輪長約最大的不同，在於大型客戶願意支付鉅額預付款。包括三星、美光科技 (MU-US) 及 SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 等業者均已取得大量保證金或預付款，有助提高未來訂單能見度，也進一步強化供應商議價能力。

模組廠庫存偏高 不代表整體產業轉弱

針對近期市場擔心模組廠庫存增加，高盛表示，模組市場僅占整體記憶體市場極小比例，即使消費性電子需求偏弱導致庫存上升，也難以改變整體供需格局。
相較之下，更值得關注的是原廠與終端客戶庫存狀況。高盛估計，截至 2026 年第二季底，三星與 SK 海力士 DRAM 及 NAND 庫存均維持在 2 至 4 週，低於約 4 至 5 週的正常水位，更遠低於過往景氣反轉前超過 10 週的高庫存情況。
高盛認為，未來一年至一年半供給成長仍將低於需求，因此低庫存狀態可望持續，尤其 AI 伺服器客戶採購後多直接投入生產，終端庫存仍維持健康。

NAND 供需仍偏緊 AI 企業 SSD 需求持續支撐

近期 NAND 現貨價格回跌，也引發市場擔憂供過於求。不過，高盛認為，NAND 在 2027 年的供需缺口將比今年進一步擴大。
報告指出，大型原廠近年資本支出主要集中於 DRAM，NAND 新增產能有限，多數投資僅用於製程升級，因此未來供給增速仍將落後需求。
需求方面，企業級 SSD 仍是最大成長動能。高盛預估，2026 年至 2028 年間企業 SSD 需求將持續快速增加，即使消費性市場疲弱，也足以抵銷相關影響。
至於近期即期價格走弱，高盛指出下跌主要集中在 TLC 512Gb 這一特定規格產品，TLC 1Tb 等其他規格走勢平穩。
值得注意的是，TLC 512Gb 價格過去一年累計漲幅接近 600%，顯著超過多數其他產品的 400% 以上漲幅，當前回調本質上是前期大幅跑贏後的正常修正。

股東回饋仍有加碼空間 回購可望成催化劑

雖然三星及 SK 海力士近期法說會未公布新的股東回饋方案，令部分投資人失望，高盛仍認為兩家公司未來提高股東回報的機率相當高。
三星現行三年股東回饋政策將於今年到期，高盛預估未來每股股利可望高於市場預期；SK 海力士同樣有望提高配息。
此外，高盛指出，若近期股價持續低迷，宣布庫藏股買回將成為市場重要利多，尤其 SK 海力士完成美國 ADR 上市後，透過買回並註銷股份，也有助降低 ADR 發行造成的股本稀釋。

ADR 上市有助改善估值 折價可望逐步收斂

SK 海力士今年 7 月完成美國 ADR 上市後，目前 ADR 價格約較韓國本地股票溢價約 30%。
高盛分析，主要原因在於 ADR 流通數量有限，僅佔總股本的約 2.4%，加上雙向轉換仍受程序限制，使兩地市場投資人結構不同。
儘管短期內 ADR 溢價難以消失，但高盛認為，隨著全球機構投資人更容易投資 SK 海力士，長期將有助縮小公司相較國際同業的估值折價。
值得注意的是，從長遠看，ADR 上市為全球機構投資者提供了直接參與管道，有助於海力士逐步縮小與國際同行之間的歷史性估值折價。

第二季表現不如預期 高盛看好第三季反彈

針對 SK 海力士第二季財報略低於市場預期，高盛認為主要屬一次性因素。
報告指出，第二季 DRAM 平均售價成長低於預期，主要因一般 DRAM 仍反映先前簽訂的合約價格，而 HBM4 產品轉換速度亦慢於預估。
展望第三季，高盛預估，隨著 HBM4 開始放量，以及新世代 DRAM 製程擴產，DRAM 出貨量及平均售價都將同步提升，營業利益有望明顯回升。
此外，由於 SK 海力士較同業保留更多一般 DRAM 價格彈性，若後續市場價格續揚，獲利表現還可能優於市場預期。

長鑫科技擴產有限 對全球市場衝擊不大

市場近期也關注中國記憶體大廠長鑫科技 IPO 後是否改變全球供需格局。
高盛認為，長鑫科技未來擴產仍以滿足中國本土需求為主，對全球市場影響有限。
報告指出，目前長鑫主力製程仍落後三星及 SK 海力士約一至兩個世代，產品也以 LPDDR4(X) 為主。
相較之下，三星與 SK 海力士 LPDDR5(X) 產品占比已達 75% 至 85%，產品定位存在明顯差異，因此短期內難以撼動全球高階記憶體市場競爭格局。
paras_en: Recently, South Korean memory giants Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS) have seen their stock prices corrected, raising concerns about whether the AI memory market has peaked. However, Goldman Sachs' latest research report believes that the market's current interpretation of HBM, high-frequency bandwidth memory (HBM) pricing, long-term supply agreements (LTA), inventory, Chinese competition, and shareholder returns is overly pessimistic, causing the two companies' valuations to deviate significantly from their fundamentals, and therefore maintaining a 'buy' rating.

Goldman Sachs points out that over the past month, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's stock prices have fallen by around 23% and 35%, respectively, making their 2027 estimated price-to-earnings ratio around 3.5 to 3.6 times, and their price-to-book ratio around 1.4 to 1.6 times, reflecting the market's high concerns about future profitability, but not in line with the actual industry supply and demand situation.
HBM prices are expected to continue to rise, with 2027 average prices potentially doubling

Goldman Sachs is most optimistic about the HBM market outlook. The report estimates that Samsung and SK Hynix's HBM average selling prices will increase by around 87% and 100%, respectively, in 2027, with each Gb price potentially reaching around $2.9, significantly higher than market expectations.

Goldman Sachs believes that AI server demand will continue to grow rapidly, but the next-generation HBM will be more challenging to produce due to its more advanced process and increased stacking layers, making it more difficult to improve yields, and HBM production will consume more DRAM wafers, making it difficult to expand supply to meet demand, with the 2027 supply-demand gap potentially even tighter than this year.
In addition, the current general DRAM prices have already reflected market trends, with prices higher than those of HBM, which are mostly negotiated on a yearly basis.
Goldman Sachs expects that as general DRAM prices continue to rise, HBM will re-establish its price premium and gradually return to its high-value-added profitability level.

Under this trend, Goldman Sachs estimates that HBM's share of Samsung and SK Hynix's DRAM revenue will continue to increase, with Samsung potentially increasing its HBM share from around 8% this year to 16% in 2027, and SK Hynix increasing its share from 14% to 22%, with further increases expected in 2028.
Long-term negotiations shift to suppliers' favor, with prepayment mechanisms becoming a new highlight

In addition to price trends, Goldman Sachs also points out that AI-driven supply chain tightness has led to large customers actively signing long-term supply agreements (LTA) with memory manufacturers, with the latest contract terms generally more favorable to suppliers.

The report notes that the current LTA market is characterized by four major trends: longer contract terms, increased coverage of production capacity, more protective pricing mechanisms, and increased prepayment requirements.

Most contracts have been extended from the previous short-term to around 5 years, with some lasting 3 years, while Samsung has stated that its long-term contracts are based on a rolling renewal model, with actual cooperation time potentially exceeding 5 years.

In terms of coverage, most companies have increased their long-term contract coverage ratio to around 60% to 70% of production capacity, while prices have gradually adopted price ceilings or minimum price guarantees to reduce market volatility risks.

Goldman Sachs believes that the most significant difference in this round of long-term contracts is that large customers are willing to pay significant prepayments, including Samsung, Micron Technology (MU-US), and SanDisk (SNDKV-US), which have all received large guarantees or prepayments, helping to increase the visibility of future orders and further strengthen suppliers' bargaining power.
Module manufacturers' inventory is high, but does not represent a decline in the overall industry

In response to recent market concerns about module manufacturers' inventory, Goldman Sachs notes that the module market accounts for an extremely small proportion of the overall memory market, and even if consumer electronics demand is weak, leading to inventory increases, it is difficult to change the overall supply and demand situation.

In comparison, it is more worth paying attention to the inventory situation of original manufacturers and end customers. Goldman Sachs estimates that as of the end of the second quarter of 2026, Samsung and SK Hynix's DRAM and NAND inventories were both around 2 to 4 weeks, lower than the normal level of around 4 to 5 weeks, and far lower than the high inventory levels seen before the market reversal.

Goldman Sachs believes that the low inventory situation will continue for the next year to a year and a half, especially as AI server customers tend to purchase and directly put into production, and end customers' inventory will remain healthy.
NAND supply remains tight, with AI enterprises' SSD demand continuing to drive growth
Recent NAND spot prices have fallen, raising concerns about oversupply. However, Goldman Sachs believes that the NAND supply-demand gap will continue to widen in 2027.

The report notes that large original manufacturers have invested heavily in DRAM production in recent years, with NAND production capacity additions limited, and most investments focused on process upgrades, making it difficult for supply to keep up with demand.

On the demand side, enterprise SSDs remain the largest growth driver. Goldman Sachs estimates that enterprise SSD demand will continue to grow rapidly from 2026 to 2028, even if consumer markets are weak, and will be sufficient to offset the impact.
Regarding recent spot price declines, Goldman Sachs notes that the decline is mainly concentrated in the TLC 512Gb product, while other specifications, such as TLC 1Tb, have seen stable prices.

It is worth noting that the TLC 512Gb price has increased by around 600% over the past year, significantly higher than most other products, and the current correction is essentially a normal correction after a significant price surge.
Shareholder returns still have room for further increases, with buybacks potentially becoming a catalyst

Although Samsung and SK Hynix have not announced new shareholder return plans at their recent shareholder meetings, Goldman Sachs believes that the two companies have a high probability of increasing shareholder returns in the future.

Samsung's current three-year shareholder return policy will expire this year, and Goldman Sachs estimates that future dividend payments will be higher than market expectations; SK Hynix also has the potential to increase its dividend payments.

In addition, Goldman Sachs notes that if the stock price continues to be low, announcing a buyback program will become a significant positive factor, especially for SK Hynix, which has completed its ADR listing in the US and can use buybacks to reduce the dilutive effect of ADR issuance.
ADR listing helps improve valuation, with discounts potentially narrowing over time
After SK Hynix completed its ADR listing in the US in July this year, the ADR price is currently around 30% higher than the Korean local stock price.

Goldman Sachs analyzes that the main reason is that the ADR float is limited, accounting for only around 2.4% of the total shares outstanding, and the two-way conversion is still subject to procedural restrictions, making the investment structure different between the two markets.

Although the ADR premium may not disappear in the short term, Goldman Sachs believes that as global institutional investors become more easily invested in SK Hynix, the company's valuation will gradually narrow the gap with its international peers.

It is worth noting that from a long-term perspective, ADR listing provides a direct participation channel for global institutional investors, which will help SK Hynix narrow the historical valuation gap with its international peers.
Second-quarter performance was not as expected, but Goldman Sachs is optimistic about the third-quarter rebound
In response to SK Hynix's second-quarter earnings report, which was lower than market expectations, Goldman Sachs believes that the main reason was a one-time factor.

The report notes that the second-quarter DRAM average selling price growth was lower than expected, mainly due to the fact that general DRAM prices still reflected previous contract prices, and the transition to HBM4 products was slower than expected.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, Goldman Sachs estimates that with the HBM4 starting to ramp up and new-generation DRAM production expanding, DRAM shipments and average selling prices will both increase, with operating profits expected to rebound significantly.
In addition, due to SK Hynix's greater flexibility in general DRAM pricing, if the market price continues to rise, the company's profitability may be better than market expectations.
Longxin Technology's production expansion is limited, and its impact on the global market is not significant
The market has recently been concerned about the potential impact of Longxin Technology's IPO on the global supply and demand situation.
Goldman Sachs believes that Longxin Technology's future production expansion will focus on meeting China's domestic demand, and its impact on the global market will be limited.
The report notes that Longxin's main process is still lagging behind Samsung and SK Hynix by one to two generations, and its products are mainly LPDDR4(X).

In comparison, Samsung and SK Hynix's LPDDR5(X) products account for around 75% to 85% of their production, with a clear product positioning difference, making it difficult to shake up the global high-end memory market competition landscape in the short term.

items.title: 馬斯克遇「黑色七月」：單月財富蒸發3630億美元  相當於虧掉2個黃仁勳
items.title_en: Musk Faces 'Black July': $363 Billion Wealth Eroded in a Month, Equivalent to Losing Two Jeff Housens
paras: 根據《Forbes》富豪榜，6 月 12 日 SpaceX 以「SPCX」代號登陸那斯達克、發行價 135 美元，首日收漲 19.22% 至 160.95 美元，市值突破 2.1 兆美元，6 月 16 日盤中觸及 225.64 美元高點，馬斯克身家因此衝上 1.33 兆美元，成為人類首位「兆元富豪」。
但好景不常，熱潮僅維持數週，SpaceX 股價 7 月重挫 37%，連帶特斯拉因 Q2 財報失利同月跌 26%，馬斯克持倉雙殺。
截至美東時間上周六 (8 月 1 日) 零時，馬斯克淨資產回落至約 6900 億美元，創去年 12 月以來新低，7 月單月縮水 3630 億美元(約新台幣 11.3 兆元)，寫下單月財富蒸發紀錄。
馬斯克身家縮水額超過全球第 2 至第 10 大富豪任一人的全部身家，約為黃仁勳 1740 億美元的兩倍多，即便排名第 2 的谷歌共同創辦人 Larry Page 微增 10 億至 2920 億美元，與馬斯克差距仍近 4000 億。
7 月最大贏家為貝佐斯，受亞馬遜股價漲 14% 帶動，身家增 290 億至 2780 億美元，超越谷歌共同創辦人謝爾蓋 · 布林 (約 2690 億) 躍居全球第三，為 3 月以來首次。布林退居第四。
分析師指出，馬斯克財富高度綁定 SpaceX 與特斯拉股價，SpaceX 上市後由「星鏈商業化＋星艦回收」敘事推至泡沫區，7 月隨獲利了結與星艦試飛延期回調；馬斯克也在社群媒體上自嘲「前台兆富翁」。
paras_en: According to the Forbes rich list, on June 12, SpaceX landed on the Nasdaq under the code 'SPCX' with an issue price of $135, and rose 19.22% to $160.95 on the first day, with a market value of over $2.1 trillion, reaching a high point of $225.64 on June 16, and Musk's wealth surged to $1.33 trillion, making him the first 'trillionaire' in human history.

However, the good times were short-lived, and the hot trend only lasted for a few weeks. SpaceX's stock price plummeted 37% in July, and Tesla's stock price fell 26% in the same month due to Q2 earnings losses, with Musk's holdings suffering a double blow.

As of last Saturday (August 1) at 0:00 Eastern Time, Musk's net assets fell to around $69 trillion, a new low since last December, with a single-month decline of $36.3 trillion (approximately NT$113 trillion), setting a record for the largest single-month wealth erosion.

Musk's wealth erosion exceeded the combined wealth of the world's second to tenth richest people, equivalent to more than twice that of Jeff Housen's $17.4 trillion, and even if Larry Page, the second-ranked Google co-founder, increased by $1 trillion to $29.2 trillion, the gap with Musk remained nearly $40 trillion.

The biggest winner in July was Bezos, who saw Amazon's stock price rise 14% and his wealth increase by $29 billion to $27.8 trillion, surpassing Google co-founder Sergey Brin (approximately $26.9 trillion) to become the world's third-richest person, the first time since March. Brin fell to fourth place.

Analysts pointed out that Musk's wealth is highly correlated with the stock prices of SpaceX and Tesla, with SpaceX's stock price rising to the bubble zone after its listing, and then falling back in July after the profit was closed and the Starship test was delayed; Musk also joked on social media that he was a 'front-stage trillionaire'.

items.title: 美出口管制反助中企 三星、SK海力士傳測試AMEC設備
items.title_en: U.S. Export Controls Prompt Tests of AMEC Equipment by Samsung and SK Hynix
paras: 美國持續收緊對中國半導體出口管制之際，知情人士透露，三星電子與 SK 海力士 (SK Hynix) 正評估未來是否把中國中微半導體設備 (AMEC) 的晶片製造設備導入中國廠使用，以因應美方進一步限制出口的風險。
路透引述三名熟悉內情人士說法報導，兩家南韓記憶體大廠約從兩年前便開始測試 AMEC 的蝕刻設備。目前相關測試尚未演變為大規模採用決策，但對總部位於上海的 AMEC 而言，若能獲得全球頂尖記憶體製造商認可，將具有重大指標意義。
更廣泛而言，這項測試也凸顯美國科技管制的矛盾效應：原本旨在限制中國半導體發展的政策，反而為中國設備商創造機會，得以打入外資在中國營運的晶圓廠。
目前三星在西安設有 NAND Flash 工廠，SK 海力士則在大連設有 NAND 廠，在無錫設有 DRAM 廠。這些廠房目前仍高度依賴美商應用材料 (Applied Materials)(AMAT-US) 及科林研發 (Lam Research)(LRCX-US) 提供的蝕刻設備。
由於議題敏感，消息人士均要求匿名。三星向路透表示，未曾在中國工廠測試 AMEC 設備，也未考慮這麼做。SK 海力士拒絕評論。AMEC 及負責執行出口管制的美國商務部工業暨安全局 (BIS) 則未立即置評。

擔憂出口限制持續收緊

美國商務部 2023 年將三星與 SK 海力士中國工廠列為「經認證最終用戶」(Validated End User, VEU)，允許兩家公司進口部分受管制的美國設備，無須逐案申請出口許可。
不過，美國已在 2025 年取消 VEU 資格，之後僅核發為期一年的許可，允許兩家公司於 2026 年向中國工廠引進晶片製造設備。
消息人士指出，即使如此，兩家公司仍擔心，美國未來限制措施可能不僅涵蓋新設備，還會擴及既有西方設備的維修、保養與零件更換。因此，兩家公司希望保留中國設備商作為備案，以便維持並升級中國既有產線，而非擴充當地產能。

中國設備商爭取國際認證

另一方面，對 AMEC 及中國新興半導體設備廠而言，若取得三星或 SK 海力士認證，將是極具份量的商業背書。
雖然中國設備商在先進微影及部分檢測設備仍落後海外競爭對手，但在蝕刻、薄膜沉積、清洗及化學機械研磨 (CMP) 等領域，技術差距已明顯縮小，且價格通常較海外產品低了 20% 至 30%。
TechInsights 副董事長 Dan Hutcheson 表示，中國設備價格普遍比國際同級產品便宜兩到三成。
消息人士指出，AMEC 設備目前已獲中國主要晶片廠採用，包括 NAND Flash 製造商長江存儲 (YMTC)，也因此讓三星與 SK 海力士更有信心，認為部分設備已成熟到足以進行測試。
中國設備商崛起，長期而言可能挑戰應用材料、科林研發、科磊 (KLA)(KLAC-US) 以及日本、歐洲設備商長年主導的晶圓製造設備市場。對設備商而言，中國仍是重要市場，例如應材 2025 會計年度在中國營收達 85.3 億美元，占總營收 30%。
即便如此，中國設備商若要全面突破仍面臨挑戰，包括冗長的設備驗證流程、售後服務網絡較小、智慧財產權疑慮，以及可能遭遇美方政治壓力。
此外，目前仍不清楚三星與 SK 海力士是否會將中國設備導入南韓本土工廠，因為仍存在資安及智慧財產權風險。
不過，美國出口管制確實已替中國半導體設備業創造發展契機。德意志銀行 (Deutsche Bank) 預估，北方華創 (Naura)、AMEC、拓荊科技(Piotech) 及 ACM Research 等公司 2026 年營收都將突破 10 億美元。
根據德銀預測，四家公司今年合計可拿下中國約 280 億美元晶圓製造設備市場 25% 至 30% 市占率，若排除微影及量測設備，中國供應商市占率甚至可能逼近 40%。
paras_en: Amid the United States’ ongoing tightening of semiconductor export controls to China, sources said Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are evaluating whether to introduce chip‑manufacturing equipment from China’s AMEC (Advanced Micro‑electronics Equipment Corp.) into their Chinese fabs to hedge against further U.S. export restrictions.

Reuters cited three insiders who said the two South Korean memory giants began testing AMEC’s etching tools about two years ago. The tests have not yet turned into a large‑scale adoption decision, but for AMEC, headquartered in Shanghai, winning the endorsement of world‑leading memory makers would be a major milestone.

More broadly, the tests highlight a paradox of U.S. tech controls: policies intended to curb China’s semiconductor progress are inadvertently creating opportunities for Chinese equipment vendors to break into foreign‑capital wafer fabs operating in China.

Samsung currently runs a NAND flash plant in Xi’an, while SK Hynix has a NAND fab in Dalian and a DRAM fab in Wuxi. These facilities remain heavily dependent on etching equipment from Applied Materials (AMAT-US) and Lam Research (LRCX-US).

Because of the sensitivity of the issue, sources asked to remain anonymous. Samsung told Reuters it has never tested AMEC gear at its Chinese sites and has not considered doing so. SK Hynix declined to comment. AMEC and the U.S. Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) did not immediately respond.
Concern Over Tightening Export Limits

The U.S. Commerce Department listed Samsung’s and SK Hynix’s Chinese factories as Validated End Users (VEU) in 2023, allowing the two firms to import certain controlled U.S. equipment without case‑by‑case licenses. However, the VEU status will be revoked in 2025, after which only one‑year licences will be issued for equipment shipments to China in 2026.

Sources said the companies remain worried that future U.S. restrictions could not only cover new tools but also extend to maintenance, servicing and spare‑part replacements for existing Western equipment. Consequently, they want to keep Chinese vendors as a fallback to maintain and upgrade current lines rather than expand capacity locally.
Chinese Vendors Seek International Validation

For AMEC and other emerging Chinese semiconductor‑equipment makers, certification by Samsung or SK Hynix would be a powerful commercial endorsement. While Chinese firms still lag in advanced lithography and some inspection tools, gaps in etching, thin‑film deposition, cleaning and chemical‑mechanical polishing (CMP) have narrowed, and Chinese products typically cost 20‑30% less than overseas equivalents.

TechInsights vice‑chair Dan Hutcheson noted that Chinese equipment is generally 20‑30% cheaper than comparable international products. Sources said AMEC tools are already used by major Chinese chipmakers such as Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC), giving Samsung and SK Hynix confidence that some equipment is mature enough for testing.

The rise of Chinese equipment suppliers could, in the long run, challenge the market dominance of Applied Materials, Lam Research, KLA (KLAC-US) and Japanese and European vendors that have long led wafer‑fab equipment sales. For equipment makers, China remains a crucial market; Applied Materials, for example, posted $8.53 billion in China revenue in FY 2025, about 30% of its total.

Nevertheless, Chinese vendors still face hurdles to a full breakthrough, including lengthy qualification processes, smaller after‑sales service networks, intellectual‑property concerns and potential political pressure from the United States.
It is also unclear whether Samsung or SK Hynix would bring Chinese‑sourced equipment into their South Korean plants, given lingering cybersecurity and IP risks.

U.S. export controls are nonetheless creating growth opportunities for China’s semiconductor‑equipment industry. Deutsche Bank projects that companies such as Naura, AMEC, Piotech and ACM Research will each exceed $1 billion in revenue by 2026.

According to Deutsche Bank’s forecast, the four firms could together capture 25‑30% of China’s roughly $28 billion wafer‑equipment market this year, and if lithography and metrology tools are excluded, Chinese suppliers’ share could approach 40%.

items.title: 營業不到六年！蘭蔻在中國首家旗艦店歇業
items.title_en: Lancôme's flagship store in Beijing's Wangfujing APM closes after less than six years
paras: 中國北京王府井 APM 一層原蘭蔻全球旗艦店大門緊鎖，320 平方公尺空間已經全部搬空，店內僅遺留拆卸後的展架與線纜。
緊鄰門市外牆，印有戶外品牌 SALOMON 標識的圍擋搭建完畢，宣告這處曾經備受行業矚目的美妝地標即將易主。
蘭蔻中國官網客服人員 5 日（周三）證實，上述店鋪的確未處於營運狀態，已於 7 月底關店，至於後續是否會另選址開設同等規模店鋪，暫時沒有更多訊息揭露。
據《界面新聞》報導，在蘭蔻官方微信號上仍能搜索到北京 APM 店的相關訊息，但消費者撥打頁面上店鋪電話無人接聽或空號狀態，選擇「添加美容顧問」也沒有顧問的聯繫方式。若選擇另一家王府井店，則有多名美容顧問可添加微信咨詢。
北京 APM 門市是蘭蔻繼巴黎香榭麗舍大街店之後，全球第二家也是亞太首家旗艦店。從 2020 年中國國慶正式開業到撤店清場，營業周期不到六年。
不過，除 APM 店外，蘭蔻在北京漢光百貨、SKP、新光天地等核心商場的專櫃仍保持正常運作。全中國範圍內，蘭蔻依舊維持廣泛線下專櫃網絡，會員體系、售後服務與單一門市相互獨立，消費者持會員賬號依舊可以在全國任意專櫃、官方線上渠道享受同等權益。
和普通商場專櫃相比，超大型獨立旗艦店不僅租金成本更高，美容顧問配置數量也需要達到常規專櫃兩至三倍，疊加持續空間翻新、物料營運開支，長期維持營運需要承擔高昂固定成本。
當越來越多消費者選擇在線上購物，大店的銷售職能不可避免會被弱化，僅剩下品牌展示價值，投入性價比持續下降。
分析人士認為，未來高檔美妝線下布局將告別「盲目追求大面積旗艦店」的擴張時代，品牌選址將更加看重坪效、客流轉化能力，門市形態向中小型體驗專櫃轉型，地標性大店只會選擇性布局少數核心城市。
此外，線下門市的考核標準也不再單純看客流打卡熱度，線上線下會員聯動、私域沉澱、新品體驗轉化將成為更重要指標。
paras_en: The Lancôme flagship store on the first floor of Beijing's Wangfujing APM has been closed, with the 320 square meter space completely cleared out. The only remaining items are the dismantled display racks and cables.
A perimeter fence with the outdoor brand SALOMON's logo has been set up next to the store's exterior wall, indicating that the site will soon be taken over by a new tenant.

Lancôme's China customer service team confirmed on Wednesday that the store has indeed been closed since the end of July and that there is no further information on whether a new store of similar size will be opened at a different location.

According to Interface News, the Beijing APM store's information is still available on Lancôme's official WeChat account, but consumers who call the phone number listed on the page are met with a busy signal or no answer. When they try to add a beauty consultant, they are not given a way to contact one. However, when they try to add a consultant from another Wangfujing store, they are given multiple options.

The Beijing APM store was Lancôme's second flagship store globally and the first in the Asia-Pacific region. It opened on China's National Day in 2020 and has been closed after less than six years of operation.

However, Lancôme's standalone counters at Beijing's Hanwang Department Store, SKP, and Xin Guang Shopping Center are still operating normally. Across China, Lancôme maintains a wide network of standalone counters, member systems, after-sales services, and single-store operations, allowing consumers to enjoy the same benefits at any counter or online channel nationwide.

In contrast to regular department store counters, large standalone flagship stores have higher rental costs and require a larger number of beauty consultants, as well as ongoing space renovation and material operating expenses. Maintaining long-term operations requires bearing high fixed costs.

As more consumers choose to shop online, the sales capabilities of large stores will inevitably be weakened, leaving only the value of brand display, with a continuously decreasing investment-return ratio.

Analysts believe that the future of high-end beauty offline layout will bid farewell to the era of 'blindly pursuing large-area flagship stores' and will focus on selecting locations with high efficiency, customer conversion ability, and store formats that are transformed into smaller, experiential counters. Only a few core cities will have flagship stores.

In addition, the assessment standards for offline stores will no longer be solely based on customer flow and check-in heat. Online and offline member integration, private domain sedimentation, and new product experience conversion will become more important indicators.

items.title: 美國光收發模組禁令傳聞攪動中美光通訊板塊！大摩、花旗如何解讀？
items.title_en: Rumors of a US Optical Transceiver Ban Stir the US‑China Optics Sector! How Do Morgan Stanley and Citi Interpret It?
paras: 一則《路透》有關美國擬限制中國光模組進口的獨家消息，週二（4 日）晚間攪動中美光通訊族群。摩根士丹利認為，若禁令成真，短期有利 Coherent(COHR-US) 、Lumentum(LITE-US) 等美系供應商承接訂單，但受限於產能與磷化銦（InP）等關鍵材料供應，美國廠商難以快速取代中國；花旗則認為，考慮到中國廠商掌握全球高速光模組主要產能，最終政策更可能保留豁免條款，而非全面封殺。
據悉，川普政府正著手研擬禁令，擬限制美國進口新一代中國製資料中心光收發模組，以強化人工智慧（AI）基礎設施的供應鏈安全。此案由主管美國電信產業的聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）主導研擬，官方盼於今年內公布並上路，惟知情人士也強調，最終規則仍有可能被修改甚至擱置。
消息一出，美股光通訊供應鏈應聲大漲。祥茂光電科技 (AAOI-US) 單日暴衝 19%，Coherent、Lumentum 同步走高，就連上游光纖材料商康寧 (GLW-US) 也跳漲近 9%。
相較之下，中國光通訊類股在週三（5 日）開盤即應聲重挫，中際旭創 (300308-CN) 盤中下跌 10.41%，劍橋科技 (603083-CN) 跌幅也達 4.06%。
根據《路透》，FCC 此次擬禁止的是「新型號」光收發器的進口，主要瞄準支撑 AI 伺服器運算的 800G 與 1.6T 等高速光模組。
不過草案目前仍有大量模糊地帶，究竟現有存量型號、已入關庫存，乃至上游零組件是否一併納入禁令，均尚未定案，這些細節將直接左右最終衝擊的規模。
值得留意的是，報導指出草案設計上將豁免「非中國供應商」，代表打擊面理論上就是鎖定中國品牌本身，而非泛指所有在中國境內生產的光模組。
換言之，若中國品牌在東南亞設廠生產，是否同樣受限仍是未知數。
此外，這並非單一孤立事件。FCC 稍早已於 7 月 22 日投票通過擴大禁令範圍的提案，禁止設備中含有「受管制實體清單」廠商所產邏輯晶片組件的產品進口，代表就算光模組本身不在中國組裝，只要內含中國廠商生產的核心邏輯晶片，同樣可能被納入限制。
往前追溯，FCC 在 7 月 28 日也才剛宣布禁止中國製人形機器人與電力變流器進口，理由同樣扣連「AI 基礎設施國家安全」；消費級路由器的進口限制則更早已上路。
整體看來，這已是川普政府對中科技圍堵政策的延續與升級，只是過去多聚焦於晶片，如今戰線已延伸至 AI 資料中心底層硬體。

產能缺口難補：美系廠半年內接不住中系讓出的訂單

分析指出，儘管消息面激勵美股相關個股走高，市場交易的本質是「訂單移轉」的想像。
若中國新一代光模組被擋在美國市場之外，北美雲端業者的 AI 資本支出勢必轉向本土供應鏈。
其中，祥茂光電作為直接生產高速數通光模組的廠商，被視為最直接的替代標的，股價彈性也最大；Lumentum 與 Coherent 握有雷射器與高速光晶片產能，輝達 (NVDA-US) 先前已透過策略投資鎖定兩者產能，兼具上游晶片供應與整機模組雙重身分；康寧則受惠於資料中心建設帶動的光纖與光互連材料需求，屬於產業鏈間接受惠者。
但分析指出，硬現實是美系廠商目前的有效產能，半年內恐怕遠遠填補不了中國廠商讓出的市場缺口。
市場預估，2025 年全球 1.6T 模組出貨量將上看 420 萬台，加計 800G 模組需求，非中國陣營產能：Lumentum 月產約 10 萬台、AOI 規劃擴至月產 50 萬台、Fabrinet(FN-US) 泰國廠仍在擴產中，合計仍遠不足以承接缺口。
反觀中國光模組廠訂單已排至 2028 年，凸顯供給端本已高度緊繃；中國廠商目前掌握全球逾七成高速光模組產能，其中中際旭創在美國數通光模組市場的市占率更高達約 27%。
分析認為，政策一紙禁令固然可以立即阻斷進口，但產能爬坡、良率優化與大客戶驗證流程曠日費時，絕非短短數月可以補齊，這也被視為後續股價最大的回檔風險所在。
一旦市場意識到紅利兌現週期遠比預期漫長，或最終規則納入大量豁免條款，樂觀溢價恐怕迅速回吐。

摩根士丹利：短期利多美系廠，長期仍卡在磷化銦供應瓶頸

摩根士丹利報告指出，此事件對美系光元件供應鏈屬於正面消息。
以中際旭創與新易盛合計約占全球光收發模組市場一半佔有率的現況推算，具備垂直整合能力的 Coherent 可望成為規模化受惠者最明確的一家，祥茂光電與 Fabrinet 也有機會承接部分增量需求。
與此同時，Lumentum 雖然自身光模組業務曝險相對有限，但其對外供應雷射器予多家模組廠，中國供應商若受限，雷射二極體（EML）供給緊張的緩解時程恐將延後，因此間接受惠。
不過，摩根士丹利的態度也相對謹慎，直言以目前非中國廠商產能，根本難以承接 AI 資本支出帶來的龐大需求。
報告並提及，Lumentum 與 Coherent 兩家公司執行長過去都曾公開倡議類似限制措施，理由是美系廠商普遍無法對中國雲端業者供貨，中國廠商卻能反向供貨給美國市場，形成不對等競爭。
報告也點出最大風險在於磷化銦。此關鍵原料供應主要來自包括 AXT 公司 (AXTI-US) 在內的廠商，Lumentum 上週才剛與相關供應商簽署新協議，Coherent 執行長數月前也隨川普訪中團出訪中國，凸顯美系廠商本身對中國供應鏈仍有依賴，這將是禁令能否落地執行的一大變數。
花旗銀行的看法則更為保留，認為此事不太可能是一刀切式的簡單規則。
花旗提出四大理由：

全球前十大光模組廠中有七家為中國企業，為美國主要雲端服務商供應逾半數高速光模組；
AI 光元件供應鏈本身已相當緊繃，中國龍頭廠商在零組件保障與先進產品研發上仍具關鍵優勢；
中國模組廠具備明顯成本優勢，是雲端業者資本支出效率的重要支撐；
且中國主要光模組廠早已布局海外產線。


基於上述現實，花旗研判最終規則大機率會納入一定豁免條款，海外產能擴張仍將是中國供應商因應的核心策略。

中國廠商曝險不一，新易盛壓力恐最直接

分析稱，若禁令最終落地，中國本土光模組廠受到的衝擊程度也不盡相同。
新易盛 (300502-CN) 對北美客戶依賴度最高，2024 年海外營收占比高達 87%，與中際旭創並列中國出口最積極的兩大光模組廠，2025 年營收約 35 億美元，一旦新品準入受阻，壓力恐最為直接。
中際旭創雖然美國收入占比同樣偏高，但因已提前布局海外產能，緩衝空間相對較大。
分析人士普遍認為，短期衝擊主要來自市場風險偏好轉變，而非業績立即斷崖，後續發展仍充滿不確定性，情勢隨時可能反轉。

兩種劇本：全面禁令 vs. 提高門檻但留活路

展望後續，市場普遍認為存在兩種情境。
第一種情境是草案大致落地，新型光模組直接被擋在美國市場門外，1.6T 及下一代新品幾乎喪失美國入場資格，至於已完成認證的存量 800G 產品，則取決於規則是否設有緩衝窗口期。
短期內可能出現客戶搶在禁令生效前加速拉貨、隨後新品訂單急凍的現象；不過歐洲、中東、東南亞等其他市場，加上中國本土算力建設需求，仍將成為重要緩衝，不至於出現業績全面停滯的局面，同時北美大客戶勢必加速對美系廠商展開導入驗證，只是產能瓶頸將制約實際替代速度。
第二種情境則是禁令歷經遊說角力後大幅弱化，最終僅提高認證門檻，而非直接祭出進口禁令，如此一來市場情緒有望隨利空出盡而修復，行情重新回歸 AI 算力需求本身的基本面邏輯。
值得注意的是，美國本土雲端業者本身其實也是這場政策攻防的利害關係人之一。若強行切斷已相當成熟的中國供應鏈，代價將是算力硬體成本墊高、AI 資料中心擴建進度受拖累。
這也是為何包括輝達在內的科技巨頭，都可能積極投入政策遊說，顯示這項政策絕非行政部門可以片面拍板。
事實上，目前美國資料中心建設已面臨嚴峻延誤，近半數原訂 2026 年投運的 AI 資料中心專案已延遲或取消，原因包括電力基礎設施不足與中國零組件供應受限；美國資料中心平均建置週期長達 3 年，遠慢於中國建設速度。
若禁令真正落地，恐將在本已供需吃緊的光模組市場進一步推升緊張情勢，直接墊高美國 AI 資料中心建設成本並拉長交付時程，對急欲維持 AI 競賽領先地位的美國政府而言，同樣是不願樂見的結果。

觀察：戰線從 GPU 延伸至光模組，供應鏈「雙軌化」恐成長期趨勢

分析認為，放到更宏觀的視角看，這次傳聞的象徵意義恐怕遠大於當下實際衝擊。
過去中美科技角力主戰場集中在 GPU 等運算晶片，如今戰火已延燒至 AI 資料中心底層硬體光模組，顯示整條 AI 基礎設施產業鏈已全面捲入地緣政治博弈。
全球光模組市場過去由中國供應全世界，如今正走向區域割裂：美國市場轉向本土加盟友供應鏈，中國廠商則被迫加速開拓非美市場、加碼海外產線布局。
對光通訊類股而言，過去支撐估值的重要支柱正是北美 AI 算力爆發帶來的訂單動能，這起事件恐迫使市場重新為相關企業的北美業務計入地緣政治風險溢價。
分析人士預期，後續資金將更加青睞兩類標的：

一是海外營收占比較低、國內算力業務比重較高的公司；
二是光晶片自主研發進度領先、海外產能布局較完備的廠商。


整體而言，這項禁令的最終效果仍存在高度不確定性，短期內或對中國光模組龍頭廠商帶來一定衝擊，但同時也可能顯著推升美國 AI 資料中心的建設成本與交付延遲風險。
長期來看，此事件或將加速全球光模組供應鏈走向「雙軌化」，即一條以中國廠商為核心，服務中國及「一帶一路」市場；另一條則以美系企業為主導，服務北美及其盟友市場。
這種分裂格局勢必降低全球供應鏈效率、推升全產業鏈成本，最終恐由全球 AI 產業的所有參與者共同承擔。
paras_en: A Reuters exclusive about a US plan to restrict imports of Chinese optical modules stirred the US‑China optics group on Tuesday night (the 4th). Morgan Stanley believes that if the ban materialises, US suppliers such as Coherent (COHR-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US) could benefit in the short term by picking up orders, but limited capacity and the supply of key materials like indium phosphide (InP) make it hard for US firms to replace China quickly; Citi thinks that because Chinese firms control most of the world’s high‑speed optical module capacity, the final policy is more likely to retain exemption clauses rather than a total ban.

The Trump administration is reportedly drafting a ban that would limit US imports of next‑generation China‑made data‑center optical transceiver modules to strengthen AI infrastructure supply‑chain security. The proposal is being developed by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), which hopes to publish and implement it within the year, though insiders say the final rules could still be altered or shelved.

When the news broke, US‑listed optics stocks surged. AAOI‑US (Xiangmao Optoelectronics) jumped 19% in a day, Coherent and Lumentum rose in tandem, and even upstream fiber‑optic material maker Corning (GLW‑US) surged nearly 9%.
By contrast, Chinese optics stocks slumped on Wednesday (the 5th) at the open, with Zhongji Xuchuang (300308‑CN) down 10.41% intraday and Cambridge Technology (603083‑CN) falling 4.06%.
According to Reuters, the FCC’s draft targets imports of “new‑model” transceivers, mainly the 800G and 1.6T high‑speed modules that power AI servers.

However, the draft leaves many gray areas: it is unclear whether existing inventory, already‑cleared stock, or upstream components will be covered, and those details will directly determine the scale of impact.
The report notes that the draft is designed to exempt “non‑Chinese suppliers,” meaning the ban would theoretically target Chinese‑brand products rather than all modules manufactured in China.
In other words, if a Chinese brand produces modules in Southeast Asia, it is uncertain whether they would be subject to the restriction.

This is not an isolated incident. The FCC earlier voted on July 22 to expand a ban that prohibits imports of equipment containing logic‑chip components from entities on the “Entity List.” Thus, even if a transceiver is not assembled in China, it could be blocked if it contains a core logic chip made by a Chinese supplier.

Looking back, the FCC announced on July 28 a ban on imports of Chinese‑made humanoid robots and power converters, also citing “AI infrastructure national security”; consumer‑grade router restrictions have been in place even earlier.
Overall, this is a continuation and escalation of the Trump administration’s tech containment policy, which previously focused on chips and now extends to the underlying hardware of AI data centers.
Capacity Gap Hard to Fill: US Firms Unlikely to Absorb Chinese Orders Within Six Months

Analysts say that despite the news lifting US‑listed stocks, the market is essentially imagining an “order shift.” If China’s next‑generation optical modules are barred from the US market, North‑American cloud providers’ AI capex will inevitably move toward domestic supply chains.

Xiangmao Optoelectronics, which directly manufactures high‑speed data‑center modules, is seen as the most direct replacement and thus the most volatile; Lumentum and Coherent own laser and high‑speed photonic‑chip capacity, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) has previously secured capacity through strategic investments, giving them both upstream chip and full‑module roles; Corning benefits indirectly from the fiber and optical‑interconnect material demand driven by data‑center builds.
However, analysts point out that the effective capacity of US firms is far from enough to fill the gap left by Chinese players within six months.

The market projects global 1.6T module shipments to reach about 4.2 million units by 2025; adding 800G demand, non‑Chinese capacity – Lumentum at roughly 100,000 units per month, AOI planning to expand to 500,000 per month, and Fabrinet’s (FN‑US) Thailand plant still ramping up – remains far short of the shortfall.

By contrast, Chinese module orders are already booked out to 2028, highlighting a tightly‑strained supply side; Chinese firms currently control over 70% of global high‑speed optical module capacity, with Zhongji Xuchuang holding about a 27% share of the US data‑center module market.

Analysts say a policy paper can instantly block imports, but scaling capacity, improving yields and completing large‑customer qualification processes take months, not weeks, and represent the biggest risk to subsequent stock price rebounds.
If the market realises that the benefit‑realisation cycle is longer than expected, or if the final rules incorporate many exemptions, any optimism premium could be quickly erased.
Morgan Stanley: Short‑Term Upside for US Firms, Long‑Term Bottleneck at Indium Phosphide Supply
Morgan Stanley’s report calls the event a positive for the US optical‑component supply chain.
